# 2 Baruch Chapter 46 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And when Baruch had spoken all these words to the people, he said to them: "In a little while I shall depart from you; after all that has happened, I shall be taken away from this place."

**2** "For I know that the land of Israel will be desolate, that Zion will be left in ruins, that the holy vessels will be carried away, and that the people will be scattered among the nations."

**3** "But do not grieve on account of these things, for the time is coming when everything that has been taken will be returned, the ruins rebuilt, and the scattered gathered together again."

**4** "For I know they will serve their enemies in captivity, and their children will be taught the ways of the nations; but do not grieve — the law will remain with you."

**5** "I go now to my fathers, as Moses went, who was the great messenger, and who left behind him Aaron and Joshua. I am leaving with you Gedaliah the son of Ahikam."

**6** "Listen to him, and he will be a guide to you; and do not forget the law, but teach those who are wise in it, so that they may not depart from it."

**7** And when Baruch had finished speaking all these words to the people, he rose up from among them and departed to the oak tree that was at Mamre.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
